_help: EDIT ME: every scene, line, choice and reward lives here. 'speaker' ids come from characters.json. 'goto' targets a scene id, or 'sceneId:nodeIndex' to jump to a specific node. Effects: cc, health, heat, level, setFlag, clearFlag, addItem. Conditions: flag/notFlag (string or array), item, ccMin, levelMin. 'chance.fail' = probability (0-1) the choice goes wrong, applying failEffects + failGoto.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: Controls. Up and down arrows move between choices. Enter or Space selects. Number keys jump straight to an option. Press Enter again while I'm talking to skip to the choices.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: R replays the last line I spoke. F toggles Focus Mode. H toggles high contrast. T turns my voice on or off.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: Free roam mode, Explore the city, has its own keys. Arrow keys move block by block and I announce every street. Enter interacts with landmarks. L looks around. P fires echo-ping sonar toward nearby landmarks. K lists every landmark in your district. G reads a numbered go-to list — press a landmark's number to mark it. U repeats your trail. M sets a marker, N hears the way, X clears it. B calls Bonnie to ride three blocks a step. Escape returns to the menu. The city is rendered in 3D around you with true spatial sound — press C to switch between the 3D street view and the overhead map, and O to toggle the 3D city sound. Headphones recommended. In the city, I reads your case file aloud.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: Everything you hear, I also caption on screen. We see this city together.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: During the story, press Escape to return to the main menu. I will ask you to confirm — press Enter to leave, or Escape again to keep playing. Your progress is saved at every scene.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: They call you Stoneface. Blind since birth. Leader of a crew that never needed you to see — only to decide.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Your sister Salena was a District Attorney. She found something in the city budget. Numbers that bled. Names that should not bleed together.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Three weeks ago, they silenced her. The papers said robbery. The silence said otherwise.

lines.speaker: stoneface
lines.text: They took the only person who ever read the world to me. Now I read them.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: Smart Glasses online. Tactical narration active. I will describe every street, every threat, every clue. Say the word and I repeat myself — key R, anytime.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: Tonight's objective: Salena's apartment. Seized by the city after her death. Her case files are still inside. So is whatever she hid.

lines.speaker: stoneface
lines.text: Then we walk. One block at a time.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: You are on Chapel Row, outside Salena's building. Police tape across the entrance. The ward is quiet — church bells, wet pavement, one idling car down the block.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: Front door lock is old brass. There is also a fire escape behind you, metal, rusted, climbable.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: Scanning. The idling car: unmarked, engine warm, two heartbeats inside. Watchers. They are not watching the front door — they are watching the street. Sloppy.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: The fire escape is out of their line of sight. The front door is faster, but the lock will talk if you rush it.

lines.speaker: stoneface
lines.text: Good. Let them watch an empty street.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: The lock resisted. A tumbler clicked loud enough to carry. Heat rising — I heard a car door open down the block.

lines.speaker: stoneface
lines.text: Patience. Or a different door.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: Fire escape. Twelve steps up, then a landing. Rusted rungs, solid enough. Third floor — her window. The latch is painted shut, not locked.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: Window open. You are inside.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: Living room. Dust on everything. Cardboard boxes, half-packed — the city seized this place fast. Too fast.

lines.speaker: stoneface
lines.text: Her perfume is still in the curtains. Three months and it's still here.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: Three points of interest. A writing desk, left. A bookshelf, right. And a bedroom door, dead ahead — sealed with something unusual.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: Desk. Subpoena drafts. Budget ledgers with circles in red ink — payments routed through something called the Harbor Fund. And a handwritten note, pinned under a stone paperweight.

lines.speaker: salena
lines.text: If you're reading this, big brother, then they got louder than me. The door remembers Mama. Faith before the stars I earned — and her song goes last.

lines.speaker: stoneface
lines.text: She knew I'd come. She left me a map in a song.

choices.label: Keep the note and go back

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: Bookshelf. Law volumes, mostly. Behind them: Mama's old music box. Brass crank, wooden case, carved initials.

lines.speaker: stoneface
lines.text: Mama's song. Salena used to hum it when she studied for the bar exam.

choices.label: Take the music box and go back

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: The bedroom door has no keyhole. Instead: a jingle lock — three brass charms on a rod. A rosary. A detective's badge. A music box crank. Touch them in the right order and the rod slides free.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: Wrong order trips a silent alarm. Choose carefully.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: First charm. The rod is cold under your fingers.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: Reminder from Salena's note, if you found it: faith before the stars she earned — and Mama's song goes last.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: Wrong order. The charms hiss — a silent alarm pulse. Somewhere in this city, a phone just lit up. Heat rising.

lines.speaker: stoneface
lines.text: Again. Slower.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: The rosary chimes — soft, like a church across water. Two charms remain: the badge, and the crank.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: The badge rings — bright, like a promise kept. One charm left.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: Mama's song goes last.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: The rod slides free. The door opens onto a wall safe — and movement. Two armed defenders step out of the hallway closet. The silent alarm was answered faster than it should have been.

lines.speaker: defender
lines.text: Wrong apartment, blind man. Turn around.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: Threat call. Two hostiles. One on your right, three steps, weight shifting to swing. One on your left, five steps, breathing like a runner.

choices.label: Back off and listen them out

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: Listening. The right one favors his left leg — old injury, he'll pivot slow. The left one keeps tapping a barrel against his thigh. Cheap pistol, nervous hands.

lines.speaker: stoneface
lines.text: Slow pivot, nervous hands. I've buried better.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: He swings high from the right — heavy hook, slow pivot, just like I said.

choices.label: Slip left and counter to the ribs

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: The right one drops, wheezing. Footsteps — the left one rushes in low, trying to tackle.

choices.label: Step aside and trip him into the boxes

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: He stumbles up — and his hand goes to his waistband. Metal clearing fabric. Gun.

choices.label: Close the distance, pin the wrist, break his balance

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: The pistol skitters across the floor. Both defenders down. Threats neutralized.

lines.speaker: stoneface
lines.text: Who posted you here? ...They don't talk. Teeth full of wire, boots with no labels. Professionals wearing nobody's name.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: The safe is unguarded. Dial is warm — recently opened by one of them.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: Inside the safe: a single data drive, matte black, labeled in Salena's handwriting — FIRST ECHO.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: I can feel encrypted partitions on it. Budget routes. Shell accounts. Names. Whatever she died for — it starts on this drive.

lines.speaker: stoneface
lines.text: You hid it behind Mama's song. Only family gets past that door.

choices.label: Wind Mama's music box before you go
Pocket the drive and slip out

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: You wind the crank. The music box plays — eight notes, soft and slightly broken. The same eight notes the jingle lock was built around.

lines.speaker: stoneface
lines.text: That's it, Salena. That's the whole song. I'm going to finish it for you.

choices.label: Pocket the drive and slip out

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: Sirens, four blocks out and closing. The watchers' car is pulling around. We go up and over — rooftops, then the alley.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: Clear. Your phone buzzes — unknown number, one ring, then silence. Someone inside the law just checked on you. Saving the number.

lines.speaker: stoneface
lines.text: One echo found. A whole city of them to go.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Chapter One complete — The First Echo.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: Rewards logged. Three thousand five hundred Capitol City Credits transferred from Salena's emergency fund. Crew level raised to two.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: New asset unlocking: Bonnie — a bulletproof SUV the crew built for you, with a voice of her own. Tomorrow, the Southside Blocks. Tomorrow, we find the man called Harbor.

choices.label: Roam the city before Chapter Two

lines.speaker: bonnie
lines.text: Bonnie online. Armor at one hundred percent. Good evening, Stoneface. I've waited a long time to carry you.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: You are at Fifth and Meridian, heading south. Next turn: right onto Ironrail Street in forty meters.

lines.speaker: bonnie
lines.text: Destination: Southside Blocks. I'll steer. You listen. That has always been the deal between us.

choices.label: Ask Bonnie about the Southside first

lines.speaker: bonnie
lines.text: The Southside is where the city keeps what it doesn't want seen. Navy work, navy pay, navy silence. A man named Marcus Kane went undercover there two years ago. The department says he's gone. The block says otherwise.

lines.speaker: bonnie
lines.text: Salena's drive references him twice. Once as a witness. Once as a warning.

lines.speaker: stoneface
lines.text: Then we start with the warning.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: You are at Keystone Avenue and Ironrail Street — Southside Blocks. Bass from a club two blocks east. Dogs behind a fence. Basketball — a court just north, eight players, one of them moving like a soldier.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: This district breathes pressure. Keep your hands open and your ears honest.

choices.label: Cut through the alley to the court

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: Ambush in the alley — a bottle across your shoulder. I shouted too late. Two runners gone over the fence with nothing taken. A warning, not a robbery.

lines.speaker: stoneface
lines.text: Noted. The block taxes strangers first.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: Corner store. Fry oil, citrus cleaner, a radio playing low. The owner watches you the way shopkeepers watch weather.

choices.label: Buy the buffalo plate — 50 CC, grants Grit

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: The owner talks to a kid at the counter: Big quiet man? Sits courtside at the run off Ironrail. Nobody guards him. He guards everybody. Two years he's been a fixture — never once seen him lose.

lines.speaker: stoneface
lines.text: Never loses. That's not luck. That's training wearing a hoodie.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: The court. Chain nets, cracked asphalt, a game running hot. Courtside bench: one man alone. Still. Breathing slow, four beats to the minute slower than everyone here.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: That is the quietest heartbeat on this block. That's him.

lines.speaker: harbor
lines.text: Blind man walks onto my court without a guard. Either you're lost, or you're the one Salena said would come.

lines.speaker: stoneface
lines.text: You knew my sister.

lines.speaker: harbor
lines.text: She found the Harbor Fund. I am the harbor, Stoneface. Marcus Kane, two years deep, no extraction, no backup, buried in plain sight. And I know who signed her death order.

lines.speaker: harbor
lines.text: But first you prove you're not the city's errand. There's a club dealer bleeding this block dry, collects every night out the back of the Velvet Room. Take his bag. Clean. Then we talk names.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: The Velvet Room. Neon humming, two exits, three heartbeats in the back office counting cash. Your call on the approach.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: A door opens early — a lookout spots you. A bottle cracks the wall by your head. So much for quiet.

lines.speaker: thug
lines.text: Alley's got rats tonight!

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: Two bodies between you and the bag. First one swings a pool cue — high, fast, right side.

choices.label: Catch the cue and snap it

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: Second guard flips a table as cover and comes around it low.

choices.label: Sidestep and drop an elbow as he passes

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: Both down. The bag is yours — twelve hundred Capitol City Credits, still warm from the count.

lines.speaker: thug
lines.text: Take it, take it— listen, that collection don't belong to the club. Voss's boys take a cut every Friday. We're just the wallet.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: Voss. Chief Voss. Logging that name next to Salena's red circles.

lines.speaker: stoneface
lines.text: The wallet talks. Good. Wallets always know who the hands are.

choices.label: Take the bag back to Harbor

lines.speaker: harbor
lines.text: Clean work. No sirens, no bodies, and you came out the same door you went in. Salena picked right about you.

lines.speaker: nyx
lines.text: She picked right about all of us.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: Two voices out of the dark under the overpass. Twin footfalls, mirrored weight. Nyx and Nia Vale.

lines.speaker: nia
lines.text: Ooh, the blind king of the block! Point us at something, Stoneface. We've been SO bored.

lines.speaker: nyx
lines.text: Ignore her volume, not her aim. We're in. The crew rebuilds tonight.

lines.speaker: harbor
lines.text: Then it's official. Stoneface, Harbor, the Vale twins. Salena's war has an army now.

lines.speaker: ledger
lines.text: Ledger here. Word travels: you took the Velvet bag and the block's talking your name. Good for business. But — the Priest wants a word before you climb higher. Old Chapel Ward. Tonight. He says: every gate has a price, and his prices are honest ones.

lines.speaker: stoneface
lines.text: An honest gatekeeper in a dishonest city. Let's meet him.

lines.speaker: priest
lines.text: Stoneface. Sit. The candles don't help you and the dark doesn't hide me, so we'll just be two honest men in a stone room.

lines.speaker: priest
lines.text: You want the waterfront. The island. The names at the top of Salena's red circles. The road out of this level has a toll, and I am the only one who names it straight.

lines.speaker: priest
lines.text: The Hurricane — a hand cannon from a Navy armory, eight hundred CC. And the Iron Chef — kitchen-plate armor that stops anything short of a grudge, seven hundred CC. Buy both, and the gate opens. Pray if you're hurt. I don't charge for that.

choices.label: Buy the Iron Chef armor — 700 CC
Open the gate — you carry both

lines.speaker: priest
lines.text: The Hurricane rides your hip and the Iron Chef rides your chest. Go on then, son. The road opens.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Chapter Two complete — The Block. Crew level three unlocked.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: Next route on Salena's drive: the Waterfront. An ambush on the road, a damaged Bonnie, an island with a casino and a woman named Sera. That is tomorrow's echo.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: Beta build complete through Chapter Two. Chapters Three, Four, and Five — Waterfront, The Takedown, and The Grand Finale — are in development. Thank you for playing Capital City Streets.

choices.label: Keep roaming the city a while

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: You are in St. Verity Hospital. They patched you and billed the crew five hundred CC. The priest's voice was the last thing before you woke: The city hasn't finished with you yet.

lines.speaker: stoneface
lines.text: Neither have I with it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Chapter Three — Waterfront and Island.

lines.speaker: tess
lines.text: Salena's drive names a boat, a pier, and a man who prices truth in fish. I'm riding shotgun. Bonnie's patched but she hears bad engines before we see them.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: Route: Industrial Row to the Harborfront. Heat is low. Weather is not.

choices.label: Take the coast road to the pier

lines.speaker: bonnie
lines.text: Contact. Two vehicles, no plates, closing from both sides. They are not police. They are not patient.

lines.speaker: tess
lines.text: Ambush! Stoneface, pick a hole and thread it!

choices.label: Kill the lights, brake hard, let them cross

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: Gunfire on the left quarter. Their lead car is limping. The second is lining up a second pass.

lines.speaker: bonnie
lines.text: My armor holds. My patience doesn't.

choices.label: PIT-turn the lead car into the ditch

lines.speaker: bonnie
lines.text: Left quarter cracked. I can still run. I will not run pretty.

lines.speaker: tess
lines.text: Two options. Nuclear armor plate, fifteen hundred CC, makes her a tank with opinions. Or street plating, free, keeps her honest and dented.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: The ambush tripped a silent alarm. Five minutes of police chase. Speed tiers rising. Eleven total — we are on four.

lines.speaker: sam
lines.text: Stoneface, it's Sam. I can hold the radio at tier six. After that you're weather. Turn where I turn.

choices.label: Follow Sam's voice through the fish market

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: Tier seven. A roadblock ahead. The car wash on the left still has steam in its brushes.

choices.label: Thread the car wash — steam hides everything
Jump the harbor curb and run the boardwalk

lines.speaker: marlow
lines.text: You the blind one Marlow's been told to expect? Boat's fueled. Papers say fishing. Engine says otherwise.

lines.speaker: stoneface
lines.text: Price?

lines.speaker: marlow
lines.text: The truth about the DA. First man on this pier who ever paid for it in blood.

choices.label: Pay him the truth and board

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: Crates: fish on top, rifles below. Marlow runs guns to feed orphans, if the harbor stories are true. His boat is the only honest one on this pier.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: Open water. City lights shrink behind you. Ahead: the island — casino glow, hotel gold, and Salena's last red circle.

lines.speaker: tess
lines.text: If Dan's still breathing, he's dealing cards in that casino. He owed Salena a favor and a fear.

choices.label: Come in quiet, through the marina

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: The island breathes different. Money louder than waves. Two landmarks: the Casino Royale, and the Grand Hotel above it.

lines.speaker: stoneface
lines.text: Then we gamble.

lines.speaker: dan
lines.text: Well well. Salena's brother, blind as her conscience and twice as stubborn. Sit. One hand of high-low, and I'll tell you what she found.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: His tell: he taps the deck twice when the card is low.

lines.speaker: dan
lines.text: Ha! The house likes confidence. One more hand, no charge. Salena used to say you never folded.

choices.label: Walk away and let him sweat

lines.speaker: dan
lines.text: Fine. Level four, like she promised. The Police Chief launders through the precinct evidence room. Three detectives sign. And the Mayor's gala? That's the wash cycle — every dirty dollar comes out smelling like charity.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: Level four clue logged. The woman in green at the bar has been watching you for eleven minutes.

choices.label: Stay professional — head for the hotel

lines.speaker: sera
lines.text: You hear me before you see me, don't you? Salena said you'd listen like the room owes you money. I'm Sera. This island is my wound and my home.

lines.speaker: stoneface
lines.text: She never mentioned you.

lines.speaker: sera
lines.text: She never mentioned you either. We both kept our best secrets.

choices.label: Tell her the truth about Salena
Keep it light — ask about the island

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Chapter Three complete — Waterfront and Island.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: Level four unlocked. The take-down waits on the mainland: a precinct, three detectives, five hitmen, and a city that finally knows your name.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Chapter Four — The Takedown.

lines.speaker: sam
lines.text: The evidence room signs Voss's laundry. Tonight the precinct runs a skeleton crew. Three detectives I couldn't buy. Be careful which one mirrors you.

lines.speaker: stoneface
lines.text: Then we audit the auditors.

choices.label: Go in through the evidence wing

lines.speaker: marrs
lines.text: Detective Marrs. She copies your last move — Salena's notes called her the mirror. So don't give her your last move. Give her a lie.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: Threat call: Marrs, front. She will repeat whatever you just did.

lines.speaker: cole
lines.text: Detective Cole, the charger. He telegraphs with his shoulders and never stops once started.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: He will commit fully. Let the wall finish him.

lines.speaker: ruiz
lines.text: Detective Ruiz keeps her gun low and her patience lower.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: She draws on the exhale. Act on the inhale.

choices.label: Close and pin the wrist on her inhale
Back off and give her the shot

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: The evidence room ledger: Voss's signatures, Wexler's charities, and five contracts paid to five professionals. Five hitmen. Five districts. They're already hunting you.

lines.speaker: stoneface
lines.text: Good. Save me the commute.

choices.label: Take the ledger and the list

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: Five names. The Dancer works Midtown's neon. The Welder, Industrial Row. The Choir hides in chapel silence. The Gardener, the parks. And The Suit — Upper Hills, where the money lives.

lines.speaker: nyx
lines.text: Point us. We'll take two. You take your three — they're yours by rights.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: The Dancer kills on rhythm — four counts, then a blade. Break his beat and he breaks.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: One. Two. Three—

choices.label: Strike on the missing fourth beat

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: The Welder announces himself in sparks — grind, flash, then the torch swing. Listen for the grinder to stop.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Grind. Flash. Silence—

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: The Choir kills where silence is a rule. He answers echo: clap once, and his footstep answers from the dark.

lines.speaker: stoneface
lines.text: Then let the church sing.

choices.label: Clap once — take him where his echo lands

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: The Gardener prunes from hedges — a rustle, a thrown blade. The rustle always comes from the dry leaves.

lines.speaker: nia
lines.text: Wet side's mine! Dry side's yours, king!

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: The Suit. One pistol, one shot, perfect manners. He will offer you a handshake first. The draw hides in the grip.

lines.speaker: wexler
lines.text: …via a city phone, amused. Do enjoy the finale, Stoneface. The gala is Saturday.

choices.label: Refuse the hand — take the wrist

lines.speaker: harbor
lines.text: They followed you home, Stoneface. My court. My rules. On my whistle they turn and you end this.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: Three shooters in the bleachers. Harbor's whistle is your metronome.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: The Grand Hotel, suite 9. Inside: the final coordinates — Saturday, Upper Hills, the Mayor's gala, and the room where Wexler and Voss count what they stole.

lines.speaker: stoneface
lines.text: Then Saturday, we collect.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Chapter Four complete — The Takedown.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: Level five unlocked. One mansion. Two thieves. A city watching. Everything Salena died for ends on Saturday night.

choices.label: Begin Chapter Five: The Grand Finale

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Chapter Five — The Grand Finale.

lines.speaker: nyx
lines.text: Gates, guards, gala. Two hundred liars in tuxedos and two of them stole a city.

lines.speaker: bonnie
lines.text: I can put you on the roof, Stoneface. Extraction platform. My nuclear heart is ready.

lines.speaker: stoneface
lines.text: Then let's crash a party.

choices.label: Go quiet over the garden wall
Go loud — Bonnie takes the gate

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: Two patrols, mirrored routes, six-second overlap at the rose beds. The third rose bed is blind.

lines.speaker: nia
lines.text: (whisper) I hate roses. They're so… confident.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: Bonnie through the gate at forty. Guards scattering. The gala just learned what weather is.

lines.speaker: bonnie
lines.text: Tell them it was me.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: Ballroom. Strings quartet, champagne towers, and four private guards who didn't get the memo about tuxedos.

lines.speaker: stoneface
lines.text: Dance, then.

choices.label: Take them in the waltz's blind beat

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: Service hall. Kitchen steam. Two more guards and a door marked PRIVATE — the Mayor's study.

lines.speaker: tess
lines.text: Roof access is past that study. Bonnie's hovering. Ninety seconds.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: The roof. And a police helicopter on station — Voss's last card, rotors screaming.

lines.speaker: bonnie
lines.text: Extraction platform up. I'll feed that rotor a machine-gun hello. You take the pilot's sightline.

choices.label: Blind the sightline on Bonnie's burst
Stand in the open and dare it

lines.speaker: wexler
lines.text: Ah. The blind auditor. Do you know what I stole, truly? Not money. Narrative. I told this city a story and it thanked me with a statue.

lines.speaker: voss
lines.text: We don't steal — we redirect. Sign the confession we wrote, and the city keeps its fairy tale.

lines.speaker: stoneface
lines.text: Salena kept receipts. I keep promises. Choose your ending — I'll narrate it true.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: The city is listening, Stoneface. Every Smart Glass in Capitol City is streaming this room. Say it, and it's true forever.

choices.label: FORCED SUICIDE — let them erase themselves
EXILE — strip them and banish them

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You do it quietly, the way she would have hated and the city needed. Two thieves end in the room where they counted.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: The stream calls it justice. Some of the city cheers. Some of it grieves. All of it remembers Salena.

lines.speaker: stoneface
lines.text: For Salena. And for every receipt they burned.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You hand Wexler his own pen. The fairy tale writes its last line in his handwriting — a confession styled as a suicide note, Voss's signature beneath.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: The city gets its clean story. The truth lives in Salena's drive, where clean stories go to be checked.

lines.speaker: stoneface
lines.text: Let the story eat its authors.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You strip them: accounts, pensions, statues at dawn. A boat at Marlow's pier, one-way, no name. Exile is a long walk past every receipt.

lines.speaker: marlow
lines.text: Ugliest cargo I ever carried. Didn't tip, either.

lines.speaker: stoneface
lines.text: Live with it. That's the sentence.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The city breathes again. Salena's drive is public. The Harbor Fund is a civics lesson. Your crew waits on the chapel steps.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: One more route on the map, if you want it. The island. A woman in green.

choices.label: Return to the island — to Sera
Stand on Chapel Row with the crew

lines.speaker: sera
lines.text: You came back. The city's hero, on my porch, listening to my waves like they're owed you nothing.

lines.speaker: stoneface
lines.text: They're owed everything. Quiet, mostly.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And for the first time since Salena, the silence is not a wound. It is a room, and it is shared.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: CAPITAL CITY STREETS — the full story, complete. Hunt the truth. Avenge the silence.

lines.speaker: glasses
lines.text: Thank you for playing. The city remains open — roam it whenever you like. Justice is coming, one block at a time.

lines.speaker: stoneface
lines.text: One echo found. A whole city of them, singing.
